description: A focused article with four substantial sections and a direct conclusion.
writing_guidance: Move quickly from context to useful guidance. Give the reader a complete answer without stretching the subject.
expertise_level: Accessible to a general business reader while still offering practical substance.
conclusion_guidance: Reinforce the central takeaway and end with one relevant next step.
avoid: invented guarantees, benchmarks, or performance targets

sections.content_instruction: Introduce the reader's problem and explain what the article will help them understand.
Develop the most important context, definitions, and decision factors.
Give practical steps, examples, recommendations, or a concise checklist the reader can use.
Bring the main guidance together and close with a useful action.
